By Nellie Andreeva ,
23 minutes ago Adult Swim‚Äôs adult animated comedy Smiling Friends is coming to an end. Series creators Michael Cusack and Zach Hadel made the announcement in an audio message on Adult Swim‚Äôs X account.

Along with the bad news, there was some good one. While the eight-episode Season 3 of Smiling Friends ended its Adult Swim run on Nov. 30, fans have not seen the last of it. Cusack and Hadel unveiled that two extra episodes will be released on April 12 but made it clear that that they are ‚Äúlittle stragglers, little rogue planets out there, not thematically related‚Äù and not conceived as a series finale, leaving the door open to revisit the series in the future with new episodes.
Cusack and Hadel emphasized that ‚Äúthis was our decision‚Äù and that Adult Swim executives were supportive of it.
The duo explained their reasons.
‚ÄúAfter we finished Season 3, Zach and I both had the same feeling where we feel pretty burnt out after putting years and years into this, but also pretty accomplished, like we just just came to this feeling we‚Äôre all like, I think that could just be it after Season 3,‚Äù Cusack said.
Added Hadel, ‚ÄúFrom the very, very beginning of the show, we always said, Oh, man, how great would it be to try to make the show as good as it could be, put 110% into it, and then go out what feels like on top, what feels like leave them wanting more, rather than people going, Oh, that show is still in the air. After several years of really, really grinding on this show, non-stop, without any breaks. 24/7, we got to a point where we just felt like that‚Äôs a good spot to end it. We wouldn‚Äôt want to be doing more seasons with half- hearted or burnt out or not feeling it. That‚Äôs not fair to us. It‚Äôs not fair to the audience to give you guys f*cking slop.‚Äù

The duo thanked fans for embracing the show in such a big way.
‚ÄúIt‚Äôs been a ride of a lifetime, Cusack said. ‚ÄúThe show got way bigger than either of us ever imagined: all the fan art, all the costumes, people sharing memes, all of it.‚Äù
They urged other shows to hire the Smiling Friends crew.
As Cusack and Hadel noted in their message to fans, the two will continue to work together. Deadline revealed exclusively in October that the duo and producer Aron Fromm had teamed to launch Zam Studios, a new Los Angeles-based independent animation studio.
Smiling Friends is available to stream the following day on HBO Max. Season 3 finds Pim, Charlie, Flint and the whole gang going absolutely bonkers once again, diving headfirst into their ultimate quest to spread joy upon the land. The series is produced by Williams Street, Adult Swim‚Äôs in-house production company.
